newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss consumer sentiment improves slightly - BfK.
newsitem.headline: Swiss consumer sentiment improves slightly - BfK.

text.p: Swiss consumer sentiment measured in the latest quarterly survey of the Federal Office for Economic Policy (BfK) improved slightly to a level of minus 35 points from minus 38 points in October, the Office said.
The index, which is calculated based on the difference between positive and negative answers, was at minus 41 in a survey conducted in July. It had shown steady declines since mid-1995.
"The main factor contributing to this marginal improvement was the more positive, that is, less negative assessment of the financial situation of households," it said.
Expectations for the financial situation, at minus one, were at their most positive levels since April 1990.

But the overall assessment of general economic development at minus 88 was at its lowest level since July 1993, the Office said. Respondents in the survey, which polls roughly 1,000 Swiss households, also showed that respondents "hardly expect any price increases," it said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
